results: 1. Detailed bedside neurological examination assessing strength in all limbs, deep tendon reflexes, sensation to pinprick and vibration, and inspection for scapular winging
limb strength (MRC) examination: distal weakness: upper limbs 4+/5, lower limbs 3/5 bilaterally
sensory examination (pinprick, vibration, proprioception): mild vibratory sensory loss
reflexes and plantar responses: ankle reflexes ABSENT
2. Serum creatine kinase (CK) level
creatine kinase: normal
3. Nerve conduction studies and electromyography (NCS/EMG) of the upper and lower limbs
nerve conduction studies: moderate to severe motor polyneuropathy, axonal more than demyelinating
nerve conduction studies / EMG: moderate to severe motor polyneuropathy, axonal more than demyelinating
needle electromyography: chronic length-dependent axonal sensorimotor polyneuropathy
4. Thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) level
TSH / free T4: normal
5. Vitamin B12 and methylmalonic acid levels
vitamin B12 with methylmalonic acid: normal
6. Complete blood count and comprehensive metabolic panel
serum electrolytes, urea and creatinine: normal
liver function tests: normal
full blood count: normal
7. Hemoglobin A1c
blood glucose and HbA1c: normal
8. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brachial plexus
not performed / not available
9. Genetic testing for facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD)
genetic testing (targeted panel or exome): heterozygous deletion in MPZ and MFN2; ambiguous copy number decrease in PMP22 exons 2-3 - CMT2A
10. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brain
brain MRI: no structural lesion
